title: Overview of Window Functions | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT Name,City,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY City) FROM CityTable
SELECT Name,City,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY City) FROM CityTable
SELECT Name,City,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (Partition BY City ORDER BY Name) FROM CityTable
SELECT Name,City,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY City) AS RowNum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY City) AS RankNum, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY City) AS RankPct FROM CityTable ORDER BY City
SELECT Item,Score,SUM(Score) OVER (ORDER BY Score ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING)/3 AS CohortScore FROM Sample.TestScores
SELECT Name,State,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY State),Age,AVG(Age),ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Age) FROM Sample.Person
SELECT Name,State,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY State) AS StateRow,Age FROM Sample.Person
SELECT Name,State,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY State) AS StateRow,Age FROM Sample.Person ORDER BY StateRow
